title: Concept: Client supplied price override honoured
description: A price override field echoed back in the order record in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: An override field that reaches the order means the amount came from the request, so any caller can set the price of a product they are buying.
applicability: Deployments that render a price override field echoed back in the order record into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: An override field that reaches the order means the amount came from the request, so any caller can set the price of a product they are buying.
